=='''Overview'''==
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a {{Rarity|Mythic}} unit. He is only obtainable through evolving [[Illusionist (Chrysalis)]].

{{EvolutionTable}}
*You also need to at least kill 5000 enemies during [[Illusionist (Chrysalis)]] form and 62.5% awakening.

*
* To get Worthy Souls (each Worthy Soul has 0.5% awakening), you need to either clear Spirit Town - Act 6 (Legend Stage), or by sacrificing {{Rarity|Mythical}} units for 12.5% each.
*'''Illusionist (Fusion)''' can be evolved into [[Illusionist (Final)]]

==Stats Overview==

|caption2="Fear is necessary to achieve evolution. The fear that, in one's current state, one could quite possibly be destroyed at any time. I thank you, White Snake. It is thanks to your presence that I have finally succeeded in surpassing both Psychopomps and Spirits."

==Selling==
Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.
